Artistix AegisPack Laptop Backpack – Black High Density Nylon, 25L Capacity

The Artistix AegisPack Laptop Backpack, Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon, Dimensions: 46 (H) x 30 (W) x 16 (D) cms, Capacity: 25 Litres, Weight: 1.0 Kg is designed for professionals, students, and travelers who need durability, comfort, and smart organization in one premium backpack. Built with performance-driven materials and a sleek black finish, this laptop backpack blends modern style with everyday practicality.

Crafted using high density nylon, the offers excellent resistance to wear, moisture, and daily rough use. Whether you are commuting to the office, attending college, or traveling for work, this black laptop ensures your essentials stay protected and organized throughout the day.

Smart Design with Optimal Storage

With a generous 25 liter capacity, the Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon, Dimensions: 46 (H) x 30 (W) x 16 (D) cms, Capacity: 25 Litres, Weight: 1.0 Kg provides ample space for laptops, documents, chargers, and daily accessories. The structured interior allows easy access while maintaining a compact and professional profile.

  • Dedicated padded laptop compartment for added device safety
  • Multiple internal pockets for cables, notebooks, and accessories
  • Spacious main compartment suitable for office and travel use
  • Quick-access front pocket for essentials

Lightweight Comfort for Everyday Use

Despite its robust construction, this nylon laptop weighs only 1.0 kg, making it ideal for long hours of carrying. The ergonomic shoulder straps are padded to reduce pressure, while the breathable back panel improves airflow during extended use. This makes the a reliable choice for daily commuters and frequent travelers. The balanced dimensions of 46 (H) x 30 (W) x 16 (D) cms ensure the fits comfortably on your back while complying with most airline cabin and office requirements. The streamlined design also makes it suitable as an office, college, or travel laptop bag .

Durable High Density Nylon Material

The Colour: Black, Material: High Density Nylon, Dimensions: 46 (H) x 30 (W) x 16 (D) cms, Capacity: 25 Litres, Weight: 1.0 Kg is manufactured using premium high density nylon, known for its strength and long-lasting performance. This material provides excellent tear resistance and protects your belongings from light rain and dust. The elegant black color enhances its professional appeal, making it suitable for corporate environments while remaining stylish enough for casual and travel use. Reinforced stitching and high-quality zippers further enhance durability for everyday wear.

Perfect for Work, College & Travel

Designed to meet the needs of modern users, this 25 liter works seamlessly as a laptop bag for office professionals, a college for students, and a travel companion for short business trips. The smart compartment layout ensures efficient organization without unnecessary bulk.

  • Ideal for laptops, tablets, and documents

Its compact yet spacious interior offers ample room for your laptop, documents, and essentials, making it perfect for daily commutes or business trips.

  • Artistix AegisPack Laptop Backpack: Secure, Sleek & Smart. Experience the best-in-class Anti-Theft & Minimalist Design with the AegisPack laptop backpack.
  • Material: High-density nylon with a 25L capacity (46cm H x 31cm W x 16cm L). The inside of the bag is made of polyester.
